svg.title: Route Orders, Not Unresolved Exceptions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-authorized-retail-operating-loop; chart type: process_flow; title: Route Orders, Not Unresolved Exceptions; subtitle: A five-stage operating loop for authorized, 3PL-backed retail.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Stage numbers indicate sequence, not performance estimates. The merchant sells its own retail inventory; recognized revenue is retail sales net of refunds, not supplier sales or payment-processor settlement volume.; caption: Automate routine routing, inventory alerts, and returns tracking while assigning named owners to stock discrepancies, unsafe products, and refund exceptions.; stages: label: Authorize suppliers and establish product records; value: Step 1: document sourcing and landed cost; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect dealer terms, supplier invoices, SKU identifiers, applicable safety evidence, and landed unit costs. Reject undocumented sourcing before publishing listings.; label: Publish inventory with explicit stock buffers; value: Step 2: synchronize available-to-promise inventory; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Connect Shopify inventory to the 3PL feed; subtract reserved, damaged, and quarantined units. Alert the operations lead when feed age exceeds the agreed limit.; label: Capture payment and route eligible orders; value: Step 3: release only fulfillable paid orders; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use idempotent order identifiers and payment-status checks before 3PL release. Send address failures, suspected fraud, and oversells to an exception queue.; label: Track delivery and close return exceptions; value: Step 4: reconcile shipments, returns, and refunds; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Match carrier events to orders, investigate stalled shipments, and track return authorizations through inspection. Reconcile each refund to the original sale.; label: Replenish selectively and measure retained demand; value: Step 5: refresh purchasing and retention decisions; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use sell-through, lead times, and contribution by SKU to replenish inventory. Suppress unavailable products and opted-out contacts from Klaviyo replenishment flows.

rect.title: label: Authorize suppliers and establish product records; value: Step 1: document sourcing and landed cost; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Collect dealer terms, supplier invoices, SKU identifiers, applicable safety evidence, and landed unit costs. Reject undocumented sourcing before publishing listings.

text.title: Authorize suppliers and establish product records
Collect dealer terms, supplier invoices, SKU identifiers, applicable safety evidence, and landed unit costs. Reject undocumented sourcing before publishing listings.

rect.title: label: Publish inventory with explicit stock buffers; value: Step 2: synchronize available-to-promise inventory; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Connect Shopify inventory to the 3PL feed; subtract reserved, damaged, and quarantined units. Alert the operations lead when feed age exceeds the agreed limit.

text.title: Publish inventory with explicit stock buffers
Connect Shopify inventory to the 3PL feed; subtract reserved, damaged, and quarantined units. Alert the operations lead when feed age exceeds the agreed limit.

rect.title: label: Capture payment and route eligible orders; value: Step 3: release only fulfillable paid orders; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Use idempotent order identifiers and payment-status checks before 3PL release. Send address failures, suspected fraud, and oversells to an exception queue.

text.title: Capture payment and route eligible orders
Use idempotent order identifiers and payment-status checks before 3PL release. Send address failures, suspected fraud, and oversells to an exception queue.

rect.title: label: Track delivery and close return exceptions; value: Step 4: reconcile shipments, returns, and refunds; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Match carrier events to orders, investigate stalled shipments, and track return authorizations through inspection. Reconcile each refund to the original sale.

text.title: Track delivery and close return exceptions
Match carrier events to orders, investigate stalled shipments, and track return authorizations through inspection. Reconcile each refund to the original sale.

rect.title: label: Replenish selectively and measure retained demand; value: Step 5: refresh purchasing and retention decisions; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use sell-through, lead times, and contribution by SKU to replenish inventory. Suppress unavailable products and opted-out contacts from Klaviyo replenishment flows.

text.title: Replenish selectively and measure retained demand
Use sell-through, lead times, and contribution by SKU to replenish inventory. Suppress unavailable products and opted-out contacts from Klaviyo replenishment flows.

Assumptions: Stage numbers indicate sequence, not performance estimates. The merchant sells its own retail inventory; recognized revenue is retail sales net of refunds, not supplier sales or payment-processor settlement volume.
